reviews.title: Worked Well and Improved My Lawn
reviews.body: I used this fungus control on areas of my lawn that were starting to show signs of disease, and I noticed improvement within a couple of weeks. It was easy to apply, and the grass gradually recovered with fewer discolored patches. Following the directions is important, but overall this product worked as advertised and helped bring my lawn back to a healthier appearance.

reviews.title: Better to use as preventative maintenance.
reviews.body: Living in southern Texas, this must be a staple as part of your Lawn Care Arsenal. The humidity is very unforgiving to St Augustine and Bermuda grass. You also cannot stick with one product, as the lawn builds up a resistance to the fungicide. I rotate this and Scott's disease X. I put it down once a month as a preventative measure and stay with that. In the past I have found that if you are being reactive instead of proactive, you can stop the spread of the fungus but the lawn does not recover as quickly with new grass. The results are amazing and it keeps my lawn looking good! It may be a couple dollars more than Scott's but it is worth it. You don't have to use as much for preservation, but will need to use more if you have an existing problem that needs to be corrected.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 12 July 2026

reviews.title: Easy to use, unexpected bonus WIN!
reviews.body: Forgot to put down granular fungicide in time, this was a quick & easy application for weather conditions in my lawn that has fungus issues every year( its in the soil) BONUS I sprayed my lilac with curling leaves on a hunch and my lilac bush has really rebounded! Lots of new growth, leaves have all uncurled & it's looking better than it ever has after struggling to establish 5 years now! Definitely will repurchase.
